entries.reason: [REQ:R2] requires acceptance/proceed rejection unless saved values and recomputed values all match, including parsed result and testCount. The implementation records executionBinding fields and validates raw SHA/HEAD/tree/command against the artifact and manifest, but validateFinalRegressionEvidence only compares binding.testCount to the manifest value saved in raw output; it does not recompute testCount from the captured stdout via finalRegressionTestCount, nor recompute parsed result from the captured output/process conditions. A stale or forged artifact/raw manifest with internally consistent saved testCount/result can therefore pass validation without the required recomputation. [AC:2] asks for command/output/result mismatch rejection, but the added tests only mutate saved fields, not a fully re-bound raw output/result/testCount recomputation case. Sources: [FILE-MAP:R2:2] src/flow/lib/run-final-regression.js executionBinding/manifest generation, [FILE-MAP:R2:3] src/flow/lib/test-artifacts.js validateFinalRegressionEvidence/finalRegressionTestCount, [FILE-MAP:R2:1] specs/344-final-regression-evidence/tests/final-regression-evidence.test.js R2 test.
